identity.description: The Defect is a broken robot that manipulates Orbs — Lightning for damage, Frost for block, Dark for burst damage, and Glass for utility. The Defect's core gameplay revolves around channeling orbs into orb slots, gaining passive effects each turn, and evoking orbs for powerful one-time effects. Focus is the universal orb scaling stat that makes all orbs stronger.
identity.playstyle: Setup-oriented engine builder. The Defect wants to establish Focus, fill orb slots, and let passive orb effects do the heavy lifting. Once the engine is running, the Defect generates enormous block and damage every turn without playing a single card. The Defect rewards patience and engine-building over raw aggression.
strengths: Passive scaling through orbs — once set up, orbs generate block/damage without card plays
Focus universally scales ALL orb effects — one stat powers your entire strategy
Frost orbs provide the best sustained block generation in the game
Dark orbs can deal enormous burst damage after charging up
Creative AI and other powers can create a self-sustaining card generation engine
weaknesses: Slow to start — needs Focus and orbs in play before generating real value
Act 1 can be rough — starting Lightning orb provides minimal value without Focus
Orb slot management is complex — channeling too many orbs can evoke useful ones prematurely
Vulnerable when setup is disrupted (orb removal, debuffs targeting Focus)
Many key cards are expensive (2-3 cost Powers) requiring energy management

strikes.note: Remove ASAP — Defect has better damage options through orbs

defends.note: Remove after getting Frost orb generation

zap.note: Basic orb generation. Upgrade to 0-cost is very good.

dualcast.note: Flexible evoke card. Good with Dark orbs for burst damage.

starting_relic.name: Cracked Core
starting_relic.effect: Channel 1 Lightning orb at the start of each combat
starting_relic.strategic_value: Free Lightning orb means you always start with passive damage. With Focus, this becomes meaningful. In early fights, 3 passive damage per turn helps finish enemies.
tips: The free Lightning orb means you start every fight with some passive damage
Once you get Focus, Cracked Core's Lightning immediately deals more damage per turn
In Act 1, the passive 3 damage adds up over 3-4 turn fights
Consider Cracked Core when evaluating Focus — your first Focus point increases the Lightning's damage

orb_spam.description: Fill all orb slots with orbs (primarily Frost and Lightning) and let passive effects do the work. Expand orb slots with Capacitor and channel orbs rapidly. With enough orbs and Focus, you generate massive passive block and damage every turn.
core_cards: Defragment — gain 1/2 Focus permanently. THE most important card for any orb strategy.
Capacitor — gain 2/3 orb slots. More slots = more passive effects per turn.
Glacier — gain 7/10 block, channel 2 Frost orbs. Block + Frost generation in one card.
Coolheaded — gain 6/9 block, channel 1 Frost orb. Draw 1. Block + Frost + draw.
Cold Snap — deal 6/9 damage, channel 1 Frost orb. Damage + Frost.
support_cards: Ball Lightning — 7/10 damage, channel 1 Lightning. Damage + orb.
Barrage — deal 4 damage per orb channeled. Scales with number of orbs.
Blizzard — deal 2 damage per Frost orb channeled this combat to ALL enemies. Frost counter AOE.
Thunder Strike — deal 7 damage per Lightning channeled this combat. Lightning counter finisher.
Reinforced Body — gain X*5 block (scales with energy). X-cost block card.
Loop — evoke your rightmost orb at start of turn. Double passive effects from rightmost orb.
strengths: Enormous passive block/damage once set up — no card plays needed
Focus scales ALL orbs simultaneously — one buff powers everything
Very consistent once the engine is running — orbs produce value every turn
Frost orbs + Focus can make you nearly invincible defensively
Scales well into late game — more Focus = exponentially more value
weaknesses: Needs multiple pieces (Focus + Frost generation + orb slots) to function
Slow setup — vulnerable in the first 2-3 turns before engine starts
Orb slot management is tricky — channeling new orbs evokes old ones if full
Biased Cognition's Focus loss can cripple the engine if not managed
key_relic_synergies: Inserter — gain 1 orb slot every 2 turns. Free orb slots over time.
Data Disk — start combat with 1 Focus. Free scaling from turn 1.
Gold-Plated Cables — rightmost orb's passive triggers an additional time. Double value from best orb.
Emotion Chip — evoke orbs when you lose HP from an attack. Defensive evoke triggers.

focus_scaling.description: Maximize Focus as quickly as possible to make all orbs overwhelmingly powerful. Even a few orbs with 8+ Focus produce incredible passive effects. This is the 'quality over quantity' approach to orbs.
core_cards: Defragment — +1/2 Focus permanently. Always the highest priority card.
Biased Cognition — gain 4/5 Focus, lose 1 Focus at end of each turn. Massive Focus burst with downside.
Consume — remove 1 orb, gain 2/3 Focus. Trade quantity for quality.
Core Surge — gain 11/15 block + gain 1 Artifact. Artifact blocks Biased Cog's downside!
Equilibrium — gain 13/16 block, Retain your hand. Block + keep your hand for next turn.
support_cards: Recycle — exhaust a card, gain energy equal to its cost. Fuel for expensive plays.
Self Repair — heal 7/10 HP at end of combat. Passive sustain.
Machine Learning — draw 1 extra card per turn permanently. Passive card advantage.
Echo Form — first card played each turn is played twice. Double your best card every turn.
Buffer — prevent the next X instances of HP loss. Damage negation.
strengths: Extremely powerful once Focus is high — even basic orbs become devastating
Biased Cognition + Artifact = 4 Focus with no downside
Fewer orbs needed — Focus does the heavy lifting
Flexible — works with any orb type combination
Core Surge provides block AND Artifact in one card
weaknesses: Biased Cognition without Artifact is a ticking time bomb — Focus decreases every turn
Needs to find Defragment and/or Biased Cognition — they're uncommon/rare
Less resilient than Orb Spam — fewer orbs means less redundancy
Consume removes orb slots permanently — can't undo it

biased_cognition_management.description: Biased Cognition is the most powerful and most dangerous Focus card. Managing its downside is critical.
strategies: Artifact — each Artifact stack prevents one Focus loss tick. Core Surge gives Artifact.
Orange Pellets — remove all debuffs by playing an attack, skill, and power in one turn.
Win fast — if the fight ends before Focus drops to 0, the downside doesn't matter.
Accept the loss — in some fights, 4 Focus for 4 turns is enough to win even with the decline.

creative_ai.description: Use Creative AI to generate random Power cards each turn, building an unstoppable engine of stacked Powers. Every Power you play makes the next turn stronger. This is a high-variance, high-ceiling strategy.
core_cards: Creative AI — generate 1 random Power card at start of each turn. The engine card.
Echo Form — first card each turn is played twice. Double your Creative AI output or any Power.
Heatsinks — draw 1 card whenever you play a Power. Powers replace themselves in hand.
Machine Learning — draw 1 extra card per turn. More cards = more Power plays.
Storm — whenever you play a Power, channel 1 Lightning. Powers generate orbs.
support_cards: Any Focus card — Focus generated by Creative AI or your deck improves your orbs
Any block card — you need to survive while setting up the engine
Hologram — return a card from discard to hand. Reuse key cards.
Seek — search your draw pile for 1/2 cards. Find Creative AI or key pieces.
strengths: Highest ceiling of any strategy — unlimited Power generation
Once running, generates incredible value every turn
Each Power stacks with previous Powers — exponential growth
Can pivot to any orb strategy based on Powers generated
Heatsinks + Creative AI = draw a card every turn while getting free Powers
weaknesses: High variance — random Powers may not be what you need
Very slow to set up — Creative AI costs 3 energy
Vulnerable until the engine starts — no immediate defensive benefit
Can generate useless Powers in specific matchups
Punished hard by fights that get worse over time (enemy scaling)

orb_management_tips.description: Managing orb slots, channeling order, and evoke timing is a core Defect skill.
slot_management: Default 3 orb slots — expand with Capacitor or relics when possible
When all slots are full, channeling a new orb evokes the LEFTMOST orb
Put orbs you want to keep (Frost for block, Dark for charging) in rightmost slots
Put orbs you want to evoke soon (Lightning for immediate damage) in leftmost slots
Plan your channel order to control which orbs get evoked when
frost_management: Frost orbs are your primary defense — prioritize keeping them channeled
Each Frost orb generates 2 + Focus block passively every turn
3 Frost orbs with 3 Focus = 15 block per turn automatically
Don't evoke Frost orbs unnecessarily — their passive block is more valuable over time
Glacier channels 2 Frost orbs and provides immediate block — excellent card
lightning_management: Lightning deals 3 + Focus damage to a random enemy each turn
Random targeting means Lightning is less reliable in multi-enemy fights
Electrodynamics makes Lightning hit ALL enemies — transforms Lightning's value
Lightning evoke deals 8 + Focus damage — useful burst when channeling new orbs forces evoke
Multiple Lightning orbs provide sustained chip damage that adds up quickly
dark_management: Dark orbs charge up (gain 6 + Focus stored damage) every turn
Evoke Dark orbs when they've charged to high values for massive burst damage
Dark targets the LOWEST HP enemy — useful for finishing off wounded enemies
Let Dark orbs charge for 3-4 turns before evoking for best value
Dualcast on a charged Dark orb deals enormous damage (evoke twice)
evoke_strategy: Evoking is powerful but removes the orb — you lose passive effects
Forced evokes (from channeling when full) should evoke your least valuable orb
Plan channel order so forced evokes remove Lightning (damage burst) rather than Frost (sustained block)
Dualcast is best on Dark orbs (huge burst) or Frost orbs (emergency block)

priorities: Find orb-generating attacks (Ball Lightning, Cold Snap) for frontloaded damage + orb value
Upgrade Zap to 0-cost — free Lightning channel every turn
Get Defragment if possible — Focus ASAP makes everything better
Pick up Frost orb generators (Coolheaded, Glacier) for defense
act1.card_priorities: Orb-generating attacks > Focus (Defragment) > Frost block cards > Card draw
act1.elite_readiness: Defect can struggle against Act 1 elites without orb infrastructure. Having 2-3 orb cards and an upgrade helps.
act1.boss_preparation: You need some Focus or enough orbs to generate meaningful passive effects for the boss fight.

priorities: Prioritize Focus cards (Defragment, Biased Cognition, Consume) above almost everything
Expand orb slots with Capacitor if running Orb Spam
Add Glacier for strong Frost generation + block
Look for Core Surge if running Biased Cognition (Artifact prevents Focus loss)
act2.card_priorities: Focus scaling > Frost generation > Orb slot expansion > Card draw
act2.elite_readiness: With Focus online, your orbs should handle elites. Use potions to survive the setup turns.
act2.boss_preparation: Ensure Frost orbs + Focus can generate enough passive block to survive the boss. 3+ Frost with 3+ Focus is very strong.

priorities: Upgrade Focus cards and Frost generators
Look for Echo Form if offered — doubles your best play every turn
Prepare for specific Act 3 boss mechanics
act3.card_priorities: Only take cards that dramatically improve your engine or cover a critical weakness.
act3.focus: Your engine should be built. Focus on upgrading and optimizing.

common_pitfalls.no_focus: Orbs without Focus are mediocre. 3 damage/2 block per orb is not enough to win fights. Focus is the highest priority card type for Defect.
common_pitfalls.too_many_lightning: Lightning orbs deal damage but don't protect you. Balance Lightning with Frost for defense.
common_pitfalls.ignoring_frost: Frost orbs are the Defect's primary defense. Without Frost, the Defect takes too much damage in tough fights.
common_pitfalls.biased_cog_without_answer: Biased Cognition is amazing but the Focus loss will eventually kill you. Have Artifact, win fast, or accept the risk.
common_pitfalls.channeling_over_evokes: Don't channel new orbs when your slots are full unless you want to evoke the leftmost orb. Accidental evokes can cost you valuable Frost or charged Dark orbs.
common_pitfalls.echo_form_sequencing: Echo Form doubles the FIRST card played each turn. Make sure your first card is the one you want doubled — don't waste it on a Strike.
common_pitfalls.creative_ai_without_defense: Creative AI costs 3 energy and generates value NEXT turn. You need to survive the turn you play it. Have block cards or potions ready.
common_pitfalls.orb_slot_starvation: 3 orb slots is limiting. Capacitor or Inserter (relic) expands your slots and dramatically increases passive value.
